logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-01 pump module decision report for Civic Water Engineering (synthetic client). Create a clean single-panel bar chart in professional engineering-report style, sans-serif, white background. Four bars for candidates P2, P3, P1, P4, left to right in ascending measured energy per acceptance run: P2 12 kWh, P3 52 kWh, P1 56 kWh, P4 58 kWh. Annotate each bar with its kWh value, quality index and raw defect count (P2: Q97, 1 defect; P3: Q80, 3 defects; P1: Q84, 4 defects; P4: Q81, 0 defects). Add small gap labels versus winner P2 (+40, +44, +46 kWh). Give P4 a distinct dashed-outline callout badge reading "0 defects — cleanest build record". Axis title: "Measured energy per acceptance run (kWh)"; subtitle: "WO-01 water-reclamation transfer loop, identical flow and head duty". Muted palette, no people, no logos, no extra text beyond these labels.
